messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired — PD#INC-4287. Symptom: high 502/504 rates from /v1/embeddings and elevated Redis 'maxclients' and Postgres connection queueing.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4287 assigned to amanda (oncall). Pager data: 1200 errors in last 5m, p50 latency up 4x.

amanda (oncall): ACK. I'm looking. Can someone paste service map / which routes are hitting the DB/cache most?

jordan (sre): seeing a big spike from embedder-prod shards. 90% of requests are to embedder-ephemeral, then downstream to pg-write and redis-session.

amanda (oncall): thanks. Maria, can you confirm pg side? Any spikes in active connections or long queries?

maria (db): confirmed — write db (pg-primary-02) has ~650 active connections, pgbouncer shows pool saturation and clients waiting. Longest wait ~8s, connection queueing. Also some repeated 'terminate_idle_backend' logs.

amanda (oncall): ok. Immediate mitigation options: 1) open pgbouncer_max_clients? 2) scale pg-replicas / promote warm replica to handle read load? 3) throttle embedder or route to degraded model variant. Which is fastest?

jordan (sre): fastest low-risk is to enable degraded-path for embeddings in the router (route to smaller model with lower concurrency). I can flip the routing flag in ~2min. That should reduce DB pressure.

amanda (oncall): do it. Also start a temporary pgbouncer pool increase on pg-primary (maria, can you do +100)? Watch CPU.

maria (db): running:

```
ssh db-admin@pg-primary-02
sudo systemctl restart pgbouncer
-- updated pgbouncer.ini: max_client_conn = 800 -> 900
```

pgbouncer accepted new config. monitoring...

ops-bot: Deploy bot: route-flag 'embeddings-degraded' set to true by jordan at 2024-06-14T15:05:12Z.

jordan (sre): flipped flag. Traffic to embedder now 60% -> smaller-model-2. Observed immediate drop in DB client connections from 650 -> 420 in ~30s.

amanda (oncall): nice. Are error rates dropping? Customer impact?

jordan (sre): 502s down from 22% -> 8% in last 3m. Latency p95 improved but still above SLO. Top impacted customers list from proxy logs: cust-acme (20% of failed requests), beta-internal (10%), misc small clients.

amanda (oncall): log a quick customer-impact note: "Partial degradation for embeddings, some requests returned degraded-model outputs or 503s between 15:03-15:18 UTC; cust-acme affected most." I'll mark incident as partial outage.

maria (db): also seeing some Redis 'maxclients' hits on redis-cache-prod-1; backlog on client sockets. That might be from session cache calls from embedder. Plan: failover to replica, or increase `maxclients` then restart (disruptive). We can also enable local in-process cache on embedder to reduce Redis chattiness.

amanda (oncall): short-term: set Redis replica as read-only primary (failover) if replica lag is low. Maria, do you see healthy replica?

maria (db): replica lag ~200ms, memory headroom ok. I'll promote replica-2 to primary for cache cluster via failover script in 2-4m. Running:

```
redis-cli -h sentinel-01 SENTINEL failover mymaster
```

Watching for client reconnects.

ops-bot: Incident log: pgbouncer pool increased, routing flag set, redis failover initiated.

jordan (sre): small note — embedder has a retry loop that multiplies DB calls when responses time out. I've patched a transient retry suppression in canary (rolled to 1 node) to prevent thundering retries. Patch command:

```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/embedder-canary --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"suppress-thundering":"true"}}}}}'
```

Canaries look good.

amanda (oncall): good. Who's owning the customer comms? I'll draft a short message for status page and ping support.

maria (db): redis failover completed, connections rebalanced, 'maxclients' OOM errors cleared.

jordan (sre): p95 latency back to ~2x SLO, errors down to 3%. We'll keep degraded routing for another 20m and then try to roll back if stable.

amanda (oncall): setting incident status -> "mitigated but monitoring". On-call handoff in 1h: Jordan will take next shift. I'm going offline for an on-call briefing in 10m but will stay reachable for major changes.

jordan (sre): taking handoff at 16:10 UTC. I'll keep degraded routing and watch DB/redis metrics. Starting a 30m playback to verify stability.

ops-bot: PagerDuty INC-4287 acknowledged by amanda (oncall) at 2024-06-14T15:06:09Z. Escalation cancelled.

maria (db): follow-up actions (to-do list):
- investigate client connection churn root cause (embedder retries)
- add better circuit-breaker in proxy for DB-heavy endpoints
- tune pgbouncer settings for bursty pipelines
- add emergency playbook for redis maxclients with a non-disruptive connection rolling strategy

amanda (oncall): adding to incident doc and will create post-incident ticket. For now: incident mitigated, partial customer impact logged, keep monitoring. :white_check_mark:

jordan (sre): ended monitoring window at 16:40 UTC, no resurgence. I'll schedule follow-up runbook updates and a short postmortem with DB and embedder teams tomorrow.

amanda (oncall): thanks team. Closing slack active thread but will keep the incident open in PD until postmortem complete.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4287 status changed to 'resolved' by jordan at 2024-06-14T17:02:15Z (after postmortem follow-up).
